This is happening now, in 2020, in North Carolina. #ThisIsAmerica #BlackLivesMatter
A well-armed White ‘vigilante’ posse led by a cop, New Hanover deputy, knocked on a Black family’s door and threatened them, allegedly due to “a case of mistaken identity” https://t.co/nxRGFY8Qij

But wouldn’t you know it: they were both white guys riding a rocket from the space privatization company started by one Elon Musty (and I swear I wasn’t going to tweet about him or the launch amid all the #BlackLivesMatter #GeorgeFloydProtests today, but…)

Thank you, @ESA_org for this clear statement of solidarity with #BlackLivesMatter and for acknowledging the inequalities and discrimination our Black colleagues continue to face simply for studying ecology, whether out in the field being #BlackInNature or in labs within academia.

Great interview with @beaniejean_ about how #BlackBirdersWeek takes on systemic racism https://t.co/UAurfRE5kv via @highcountrynews 
#AskABlackBirder #BlackAFinSTEM #BlackLivesMatter

Following #BlackBirdersWeek #AskABlackBirder #BlackAFinSTEM while standing in a crowd of a few 100s masked n peaceful people in front of Raleigh Municipal Building, in solidarity with #BlackLivesMatter at @RaleighPACT event right now. Surreal moment in all my years in America.

@AdrianaHeguy @KarenAttiah @nytimes Exactly! How can the paper that published the #1619Project publish this during this week of #BlackLivesMatter uprising? Just… how?? How broken is their editorial process??

I’ve had really mixed feelings watching friends celebrate #SpaceX launch at a time when my TL was filling w #BlackLivesMatter, #GeorgeFloydProtests, and #BlackBirdersWeek. Thank you @marinakoren for this necessary critique of the false symbolism/hope projected by space programs.

In ep6 of @science_candle, I interviewed @nilonch (+Paige Warren) on: Humans and Nature in the City. It was 2015 and I asked Dr. Nilon about #BlackLivesMatter uprisings in Ferguson+Baltimore that summer in context of #environmentaljustice+#urbanecology https://t.co/nDOhBS3xtv

Heartbreaking to hear Christian Cooper say (paraphrased): “As a Black, gay, non-Christian man, I do not feel safe traveling to Texas even though I know there are some amazing places to go birding there.” #BlackBirdersWeek #BlackInNature #BlackLivesMatter

That was the most remarkable 2 hours I have spent watching a livestream (with >2.7K viewers) in a while. And definitely the most relaxed and joyful I have felt in weeks! This is why it is important to celebrate #BlackBirdersWeek during the #BlackLivesMatter #Uprising2020! ✊🏽

Thank you @Tykee_James @kassthefish @n8ture_al @hood_naturalist @JeffreyMWard @itsafronomics and Christian Cooper for bringing so much joy about birds and nature to such a bleak moment. You showed why being #BlackInNature and #BlackBirdersWeek is crucial to #BlackLivesMatter. 🙏🏽
Colorful World of Birding Has Conspicuous Lack of People of Color #BlackBirdersWeek #BlackInNature #BlackAFinSTEM #BlackLivesMatter  https://t.co/59ohC4Umqi via @NatGeo

A 'task force'? Like we need another one of those to address long-term disparities from systemic racism. Granted, Gov Cooper's hands are rather tied by GOP.
NC Gov. Cooper signs order to address disparities in black and brown communities https://t.co/newC6Xw3Qv #BlackLivesMatter

Join me on Facebook Live on @audubonsociety’s page in 35-ish minutes (7pm EDT) as we listen to @naturallywild__, @1blackbirder, et al. discuss the dangers, challenges, and joys of Birding While Black in America (and elsewhere). #BlackBirdersWeek #BlackInNature #BlackLivesMatter. https://t.co/yPjidMDwCc
D.C. mayor has huge #BlackLivesMatter name painted on street leading to White House https://t.co/4LOaWQeDVf via @nbcnews

While the focus today is justly on academia/STEM in US, given this historic moment in the #BlackLivesMatter movement, this is not just an American problem. The exclusion and exploitation of oppressed peoples is a feature of academia everywhere. #Strike4BlackLives #ShutDownSTEM
There are uncomfortable parallels between the United States in 2020 and South Africa in the dying days of white rule. https://t.co/x0vhA7cLxf #BlackLivesMatter

Immigrants stage a hunger strike for Black lives inside ICE detention facility https://t.co/HEE6AwV82B #prism #blm #ice #immigrantdetention #immigration #minneapolis #racialjustice #racism #icedetention #georgefloyd #m4bl #blacklivesnatter

One way to fight climate change: Make your own glaciers. My friend the photojournalist @AratiKumarRao reports on how Ladakhis are trying to adapt to #climatechange inflicted on them by consumers in the fossil fuel based global capitalist economy https://t.co/ufuj1mTu4a @NatGeoMag
#ACAB. A teen’s killing stirs #BlackLivesMatter protests in Brazil https://t.co/eHwBlIhOYN

Check yourself against this checklist. In all seriousness. And reflect on why, and what this means, and what you might do differently going forward.
You May Be Your Black Colleagues’ Amy Cooper  – #BLM Guest Post | The Professor Is In https://t.co/hT6RM1x1Pb #BlackintheIvory

Well, as it turns out: People who care about the lives and rights of others—esp marginalized Black people—wear masks and are careful in maintaining social distancing even when engaging in mass protests… huh, who would’ve thunk it? #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/ati50fjD76

After weeks—nay, months—of being stuck creatively, unable to string more‘n a few words together, I somehow managed to write a 1900+ word essay (on mentoring Black/POC students during #COVID19 + #BlackLivesMatter) in ~2 hours this afternoon. Hope to have it ready to share soon.

My essay on mentoring Black students during #COVID__19 #pandemic &  #BlackLivesMatter uprising is up @ASMicrobiology! Please read+RT: 
COVID-19 and the Black Lives Matter Movement: Managing Academic Realities https://t.co/Bnd7sPoeSf
#BlackintheIvory #BlackAndSTEM #BlackAFINSTEM
